rationale: Reads Terah's age of 70 in Genesis 11:26 as Abraham's birth offset. Everything upstream of Abraham is identical to the Masoretic chronology, so only the records that actually differ are listed here.

birthOffsetFromFather.calculationMethod: terah.ageAtFatheringAbramNahorHaran, read as Abraham's own birth offset

records.notes: Genesis 11:26 gives one age for three sons and does not say Abram was the eldest, so treating 70 as Abraham's birth offset is an interpretation. Kept as a labelled alternate, never VERIFIED as an explicit birth age. See docs/DATA_SOURCING.md section 4a.
